question: Where can I find a golf course within 100 kilometers travel time or distance from Eddie C. Moore Park, Clearwater, FL?
sql: WITH start_point_geom AS ( SELECT geometry::geography AS geom FROM parks WHERE park_name ILIKE '%Eddie C. Moore Park%' AND ST_Intersects(geometry, (SELECT geometry FROM regions WHERE region_name ILIKE '%Clearwater%' AND border_type = 'city' LIMIT 1)) LIMIT 1 ) SELECT poi_name AS name, addr_state, addr_city FROM pois, start_point_geom WHERE leisure = 'golf_course' AND ST_DWithin(pois.geometry::geography, start_point_geom.geom, 100000) UNION ALL SELECT park_name AS name, NULL AS addr_state, NULL AS addr_city FROM parks, start_point_geom WHERE leisure = 'golf_course' AND ST_DWithin(parks.geometry::geography, start_point_geom.geom, 100000);
